name: agentbox-vscode
description: AgentBox: Codex app-server runtime with a webview chat sidebar, inline approvals, and file context.

agentbox.runtime.description: Runtime: real Codex app-server, or the fake runtime for UI testing.

agentbox.taskProfile.description: Task budget profile: simple = static files (8 steps / 90s), code = normal coding (20 / 180s), research = multi-step (30 / 300s).

agentbox.loopDetection.enabled.description: Stop a turn when the same tool call keeps failing or tools fail consecutively.

agentbox.loopDetection.maxRepeatedFailur.description: Stop after the same tool name+args fails this many times.

agentbox.loopDetection.maxConsecutiveFai.description: Stop after this many consecutive tool failures.

agentbox.codex.command.description: Codex executable. Use an absolute path if codex is not on PATH.

agentbox.codex.provider.description: Provider id written to the isolated CODEX_HOME/config.toml.

agentbox.codex.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible provider base URL (Codex uses the Responses API).

agentbox.codex.apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name used as Codex env_key.

agentbox.codex.scope.description: internal = intranet model; external = user-confirmed public provider.

agentbox.codex.home.description: Persistent CODEX_HOME. Empty = extension global storage.

agentbox.codex.autoSetupSandbox.description: On Windows, run windowsSandbox/setupStart once when readiness is notConfigured.

agentbox.codex.extraInstructions.markdownDescription: Additional developer instructions appended to AgentBox's built-in Codex instructions. The built-in instructions already cover Windows/PowerShell usage and file hygiene (avoid patch/helper/browser-profile files).

agentbox.files.denyWrite.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for paths the file policy denies when Codex requests approval. Paths visible in the approval payload are checked; commands containing browser/profile junk markers are denied, and browser-preview commands require confirmation.

agentbox.envFile.description: Optional .env file for local testing. ${workspaceFolder} is expanded. Prefer Set API Key / SecretStorage.

agentbox.limits.turnTimeoutMs.description: Optional per-turn timeout override. Leave empty to use the selected task profile.

agentbox.limits.maxSteps.description: Optional max steps override. Leave empty to use the selected task profile.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o agentbox-0.3.0.vsix
